texts.title: Share of women with raised blood pressure, 1996
texts.subtitle: Share of adult women aged 18 years and older with raised blood pressure. Raised blood pressure (BP) is defined as systolic BP ≥140 mmHg, or diastolic BP ≥90 mmHg.
texts.source_note:
Source: NCD Risk Factor Collaboration (NCD-RisC)
Note: To allow comparisons between countries and over time this metric is age-standardized.
